# DATA

Foote novelty threshold determined WITHIN a given conversation. Predicted topic shifts are based on turns that are a given standard deviation away from that threshold.

```{r}
# load foote novelty data
foote <- read.csv("./data/output/full-sample/0.2_foote_20_kernel_full_sample_tile_4_turn_split_sentences.csv")
# load full data
df_raw <- read.csv("./data/output/full-sample/full_sample_tile_4_turn_split_sentences.csv")
# turn angle data
turn_angle <- read.csv("./data/output/full-sample/full_sample_tile_4_turn_split_sentences_turn_angle.csv")

# merge turn angle and foote novelty with full df
df <- df_raw |>
  select(transcript_id, A_start_turn, euclidean_distance) |>
  left_join(turn_angle, by = c("transcript_id", "A_start_turn")) |>
  left_join(foote |>
              select(transcript_id, A_start_turn, predicted_shift),
            by = c("transcript_id", "A_start_turn")) |>
  distinct()

```

# EXAMPLE
```{r}
# plot example transcript with predicted shifts
example_transcript <- unique(df$transcript_id)[200]
example <- df |> filter(transcript_id == example_transcript)
predicted_shifts <- example |> filter(predicted_shift == 1)
threshold <- foote |> filter(transcript_id == example_transcript) |> 
  summarize(threshold = mean(threshold)) |>
  pull(threshold)
  

ggplot(example, aes(x = turn_index, y = cosine_turn)) +
  labs(title = paste0("transcript id = ", example_transcript),
       y = "Turn Angle",
       x = "Turn Index") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = threshold) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(data = predicted_shifts, aes(xintercept = turn_index),
             color = "purple", alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_classic()
```


# SHIFTS
```{r}
# identify "blocks" when predicted_shift = 1 for multiple rows
# rle = run length encoding
df <- df |>
  arrange(transcript_id, turn_index) |>
  group_by(transcript_id) |>
  mutate(shift_run = with(rle(predicted_shift), rep(seq_along(lengths), lengths)),
         shift_block = ifelse(predicted_shift == 1, shift_run, NA)) |>
  ungroup()

# get average step and turn across all transcripts
mean_values <- df |>
  summarize(mean_step = mean(euclidean_distance, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_turn = mean(cosine_turn, na.rm = TRUE))

# get topic transitions
topics <- df |>
  filter(predicted_shift == 1) |>
  group_by(transcript_id, shift_block) |>
  summarize(start_index = min(turn_index),
            end_index = max(turn_index),
            .groups = "drop")

# define function to get K number of events before and after transitions
get_windows <- function(df, topics, k) {
  results <- list() 
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(topics))) {
    t <- topics[i, ]
    data <- df |>
      filter(transcript_id == t$transcript_id) 
    
    # before window
    before <- data |>
      filter(turn_index < t$start_index) |>
      arrange(desc(turn_index)) |>
      slice_head(n = k)
    
    if (nrow(before) == k && all(before$predicted_shift == 0)) {
      before$relative_pos <- -seq_len(k)
      before$event_id <- i
      results[[length(results) + 1]] <- before }
    
    # after window
    after <- data |>
      filter(turn_index > t$end_index) |>
      arrange(turn_index) |>
      slice_head(n = k)
    
    if (nrow(after) == k && all(after$predicted_shift == 0)) {
      after$relative_pos <- seq_len(k)
      after$event_id <- i
      results[[length(results) + 1]] <- after}
    
  } # end topic loop
  
  bind_rows(results)
  
} # end function

```

# PLOT
```{r}
# 4 turns = roughly 30 seconds of conversation
# so window size = 1 (30 seconds before and after), window size = 2 (1 minute before and after)
# get average euclidean distance and cosine turn before and after predicted shifts

# define window size range
window_sizes <- 1:6

df_windows <- map_df(window_sizes, ~{
  w <- get_windows(df, topics, .x)
  w$window_size <- .x
  w})

# get summary
df_summary <- df_windows |>
  group_by(window_size, relative_pos) |>
  summarize(mean_step = mean(euclidean_distance, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_step = sd(euclidean_distance, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            mean_turn = mean(cosine_turn, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_turn = sd(cosine_turn, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

summary_collapsed <- df_windows |>
  mutate(period = ifelse(relative_pos < 0, "before", "after")) |>
  group_by(window_size, period) |>
  summarize(mean_step = mean(euclidean_distance, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_step = sd(euclidean_distance, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            mean_turn = mean(cosine_turn, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_turn = sd(cosine_turn, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

# add data point for at transition too
at_transition <- df |>
  filter(predicted_shift == 1) |>
  summarize(mean_step = mean(euclidean_distance, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_step = sd(euclidean_distance, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            mean_turn = mean(cosine_turn, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_turn = sd(cosine_turn, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

at_transition <- data.frame(window_size = c(1:6),
                            period = "at",
                            mean_step = at_transition$mean_step,
                            se_step = at_transition$se_step,
                            mean_turn = at_transition$mean_turn,
                            se_turn = at_transition$se_turn, 
                            n = at_transition$n)

summary_collapsed <- rbind(summary_collapsed, at_transition)
summary_collapsed$period <- factor(summary_collapsed$period,
                                   levels = c("before", "at", "after"))

```

```{r}
# plot
ggplot(summary_collapsed, aes(x = mean_step, y = mean_turn, color = period)) +
  # plot averages across all conversations
  geom_point(data = mean_values, aes(x = mean_step, y = mean_turn), color = "black") +
  geom_vline(data = mean_values, aes(xintercept = mean_step), 
             color = "black", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_hline(data = mean_values, aes(yintercept = mean_turn),
             color = "black", linetype = "dotted") +
  # plot before and after transitions
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  # step SE
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = mean_step - se_step,
                     xmax = mean_step + se_step),
                 height = 0.001) +
  # turn SE
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_turn - se_turn,
                    ymax = mean_turn + se_turn),
                width = 0.001) +
  # facet to show range
  facet_wrap(.~window_size, axes = "all") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#1e475c", "#b75044", "#eec773"), name = NULL) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Moment to Moment Step Length\n(Euclidean Distance)",
       y = "Moment to Moment Turn Angle\n(Cosine Similarity)") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# just one turn example
summary_collapsed |>
  filter(window_size == 1) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_step, y = mean_turn, color = period)) +
  # plot averages across all conversations
  geom_point(data = mean_values, aes(x = mean_step, y = mean_turn), color = "black") +
  geom_vline(data = mean_values, aes(xintercept = mean_step), 
             color = "black", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_hline(data = mean_values, aes(yintercept = mean_turn),
             color = "black", linetype = "dotted") +
  # plot before and after transitions
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  # step SE
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = mean_step - se_step,
                     xmax = mean_step + se_step),
                 height = 0.0005) +
  # turn SE
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_turn - se_turn,
                    ymax = mean_turn + se_turn),
                width = 0.0005) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#1e475c", "#b75044", "#eec773"), name = NULL) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Moment to Moment Step Length\n(Euclidean Distance)",
       y = "Moment to Moment Turn Angle\n(Cosine Similarity)") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}


# merge turn angle and foote novelty with full df
df <- df_raw |>
  select(transcript_id, A_start_turn, euclidean_distance) |>
  left_join(turn_angle, by = c("transcript_id", "A_start_turn")) |>
  left_join(
    foote |>
      select(transcript_id, A_start_turn, predicted_shift),
    by = c("transcript_id", "A_start_turn")
  ) |>
  distinct()

# identify "blocks" when predicted_shift = 1 for multiple rows
df <- df |>
  arrange(transcript_id, turn_index) |>
  group_by(transcript_id) |>
  mutate(
    shift_run = with(rle(predicted_shift), rep(seq_along(lengths), lengths)),
    shift_block = ifelse(predicted_shift == 1, shift_run, NA)
  )

# get average step and turn across all transcripts
mean_values <- df |>
  ungroup() |>
  summarize(
    mean_step = mean(euclidean_distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_turn = mean(cosine_turn, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# get topic transitions (events)
topics <- df |>
  filter(predicted_shift == 1) |>
  group_by(transcript_id, shift_block) |>
  summarize(
    start_index = min(turn_index),
    end_index   = max(turn_index),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_split <- df |> group_by(transcript_id) |> group_split()
#df_split <- df |> group_split(transcript_id)
names(df_split) <- df |> group_keys() |> pull(transcript_id)

# function to get windows
get_windows <- function(df_split, topics, k) {

  results <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(topics))) {

    t <- topics[i, ]

    data <- df_split[[as.character(t$transcript_id)]]

    # BEFORE
    before <- data |>
      filter(turn_index < t$start_index) |>
      arrange(desc(turn_index)) |>
      slice_head(n = k)

    if (nrow(before) == k && all(before$predicted_shift == 0)) {
      before$relative_pos <- -seq_len(k)
      before$event_id <- i
      results[[length(results) + 1]] <- before
    }

    # AFTER
    after <- data |>
      filter(turn_index > t$end_index) |>
      arrange(turn_index) |>
      slice_head(n = k)

    if (nrow(after) == k && all(after$predicted_shift == 0)) {
      after$relative_pos <- seq_len(k)
      after$event_id <- i
      results[[length(results) + 1]] <- after
    }
  }

  bind_rows(results)
}

# define window sizes
window_sizes <- 1:5

# extract windows
df_windows <- map_df(window_sizes, ~{
  w <- get_windows(df_split, topics, .x)
  w$window_size <- .x
  w
})

# 🔑 EVENT-LEVEL aggregation (fixes SE issue)
event_level <- df_windows |>
  mutate(period = ifelse(relative_pos < 0, "before", "after")) |>
  group_by(window_size, event_id, period) |>
  summarize(
    step = mean(euclidean_distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    turn = mean(cosine_turn, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# final summary (SE across events)
summary_collapsed <- event_level |>
  group_by(window_size, period) |>
  summarize(
    mean_step = mean(step),
    se_step   = sd(step) / sqrt(n()),
    mean_turn = mean(turn),
    se_turn   = sd(turn) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# plot
ggplot(summary_collapsed,
       aes(x = mean_step, y = mean_turn, color = period)) +

  # overall mean reference
  geom_point(
    data = mean_values,
    aes(x = mean_step, y = mean_turn),
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = mean_values,
    aes(xintercept = mean_step),
    color = "black",
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    data = mean_values,
    aes(yintercept = mean_turn),
    color = "black",
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +

  # before vs after points
  geom_point(size = 3) +

  # horizontal SE (euclidean)
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = mean_step - se_step,
      xmax = mean_step + se_step
    ),
    height = 0.02
  ) +

  # vertical SE (cosine)
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_turn - se_turn,
      ymax = mean_turn + se_turn
    ),
    width = 0.02
  ) +

  facet_wrap(. ~ window_size) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#b75044", "#eec773"), name = NULL) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Moment to Moment Step Length\n(Euclidean Distance)",
    y = "Moment to Moment Turn Angle\n(Cosine Similarity)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
